metadata.title: Lithium abundance in a turnoff halo star on an extreme orbit

notes: No eligible stars. The paper's target, WISE J0725–2351 (also WISE J072543.88–235119.7), is explicitly described as an extreme halo star on a bound, retrograde Galactic orbit (T:p1-b5, T:p1-b9), and the conclusion repeats this classification (T:p3-b10). The discussion that it could have been born outside the Galaxy and later accreted (T:p4-b1) concerns its origin, not its present-day binding state, and therefore does not establish Galactic unbound candidacy.
